page_title: CAD 0-3 RMA | Cadiz CF v Real Madrid 26/11/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' Guillermo Cuadra is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+5' Brian Ocampo (Cadiz) has a sight of goal, fires a shot in from distance towards the left post and forces a good save out of Andriy Lunin.
90+3' Guillermo Cuadra blows his whistle as Lucas Vazquez (Real Madrid) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
90' We will have 5 min. of added time.
90' Darwin Machis (Cadiz) attempts to slip the ball through the defence, but is unable to find any of his teammates.
88' Carlo Ancelotti has decided to substitute Daniel Carvajal and he is replaced by Fran Garcia (Real Madrid).
88' Nicolas Paz (Real Madrid) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Federico Valverde.
86' What a goal-scoring opportunity! Joselu (Real Madrid) finds some space inside the box and gets in a strike, but the shot is brilliantly blocked by one of the defending players sliding in.
85' Maximiliano Gomez (Cadiz) decides to have a go at goal from the long-range free kick, but the wall jumps as one and makes the block. Danger averted!
84' Antonio Rudiger (Real Madrid) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
84' The Cadiz CF players are displaying brilliant short passes and great ball movement. They are waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
79' Substitution. Joseba Zaldua makes his way off the pitch and Brian Ocampo (Cadiz) comes on as his replacement.
79' The referee signals a substitution. David Gil (Cadiz) is brought on as a substitute for Conan Ledesma.
78' Carlo Ancelotti has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Gonzalo Garcia (Real Madrid) replacing Rodrygo.
78' The substitution has been made. Lucas Vazquez (Real Madrid) has replaced Jude Bellingham.
76' Rodrygo (Real Madrid) is having a lively performance. He is causing problems and wanting the ball at every opportunity.
74' 0 - 3 Goal! Rodrygo produces a great pass that finds Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid) inside the penalty area, who takes advantage of the situation to rifle a shot into the bottom right corner. 0:3.
72' The corner from Toni Kroos (Real Madrid) is hurriedly cleared.
72' Real Madrid are about to take a free kick from a very dangerous position.
71' Javi Hernandez (Cadiz) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
70' Alex Fernandez (Cadiz) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
70' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Daniel Ceballos (Real Madrid) is coming onto the pitch as Luka Modric cannot continue after picking up an injury.
68' A pass into the box finds Maximiliano Gomez (Cadiz) unmarked. He carefully places a shot towards the middle of the goal, but a brilliant last-ditch save by Andriy Lunin denies him.
67' Ivan Alejo (Cadiz) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
66' Sergio has decided to make a change. Ivan Alejo (Cadiz) replaces Victor Chust.
66' Substitution. Chris Ramos walks off the pitch and Maximiliano Gomez (Cadiz) comes on as a substitute.
64' 0 - 2 Goal! Luka Modric tees up Rodrygo (Real Madrid) inside the box, and he keeps his cool to find the right side of the goal. 0:2.
64' Luka Modric (Real Madrid) latches onto a pass and lets fly at goal from the edge of the box. The shot beats the keeper but smashes against the left post. Good effort!
63' Darwin Machis (Cadiz) sends a cross into the box, but Andriy Lunin comes off his line to gather the ball.
61' Cadiz CF are showcasing great team work and neat passing moves.
57' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Darwin Machis (Cadiz) will replace Robert Navarro.
56' Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Conan Ledesma intercepts the ball.
55' Antonio Rudiger (Real Madrid) sends a long ball forward to Rodrygo, but he put too much power and the chance is gone.
51' Neat passing move from Real Madrid in order to create new attacking opportunities.
49' Toni Kroos (Real Madrid) takes a direct free kick.
47' The foul by Daniel Carvajal (Real Madrid) was seen by Guillermo Cuadra who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
47' Daniel Carvajal (Real Madrid) commits a foul and Guillermo Cuadra immediately signals a free kick.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+4' Guillermo Cuadra blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+2' The goalkeeper punched the ball away after Luka Modric (Real Madrid) took the corner.
45' 3 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' Rodrygo (Real Madrid) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
44' Guillermo Cuadra blows his whistle and it's Rodrygo (Real Madrid) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
42' Luka Modric (Real Madrid) tries to find Rodrygo, but he puts too much power on the through ball.
40' Cadiz CF have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
40' Roger Marti (Cadiz) was close to scoring after he unleashed a powerful shot which went a whisker wide of the right post.
38' Toni Kroos (Real Madrid) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.
37' Real Madrid have a goal-scoring opportunity from a mid-range free kick.
35' Nacho Fernandez (Real Madrid) shows his brilliant passing ability after picking out Daniel Carvajal with a fine lofted pass.
33' Close effort! Lucas Pires (Cadiz) takes the resulting free kick from a promising distance, but he sends it narrowly wide of the right post.
32' Ferland Mendy (Real Madrid) receives a yellow card from the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
31' A pass by Federico Valverde (Real Madrid) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end. The ball is out of play. Cadiz CF will take a throw-in.
29' Antonio Rudiger (Real Madrid) leaps like a salmon and plants a great close-range header from the corner towards goal, but the effort is blocked at the last moment.
29' Toni Kroos (Real Madrid) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.
29' Conan Ledesma (Cadiz) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
28' Conan Ledesma (Cadiz) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
26' Fali (Cadiz) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Andriy Lunin, who smothers the ball.
25' Lucas Pires (Cadiz) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.
24' Javi Hernandez (Cadiz) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates.
23' Rodrygo (Real Madrid) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
21' Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Guillermo Cuadra blows his whistle for a foul.
16' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Cadiz CF comes to nothing.
14' 0 - 1 That was a nice piece of skill by Rodrygo (Real Madrid)! He skips past a few defenders and manages to fire a superb effort that goes into the top right corner. The score is 0:1.

13' Robert Navarro (Cadiz) attempts to convert a lofted cross as he jumps high and heads the ball to the middle of the goal. Andriy Lunin shows his brilliant reflexes and pulls off a glorious save to stop the ball from hitting the net.
11' Chris Ramos (Cadiz) crashes a header just wide of the left post from close range after a searching cross. He should have scored!
11' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Alex Fernandez (Cadiz) takes it short.
10' A pass by Daniel Carvajal (Real Madrid) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
8' Javi Hernandez (Cadiz) attempts to score from a mid-range free kick, but he curls his effort a few inches over the crossbar.
8' Cadiz CF have an opportunity from a mid-range free kick.
7' Javi Hernandez (Cadiz) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
3' Federico Valverde (Real Madrid) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
2' It's a nice effort by Rodrygo (Real Madrid) from the edge of the box, but it's low towards the middle of the goal and straight down the throat of Conan Ledesma. Easy save.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
It looked like the long-range shot by Roger Marti (Cadiz) would end up in the net, but the effort went painfully wide of the right post. The goalkeeper was quite lucky this time.
Cadiz CF will kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Guillermo Cuadra.
